title: Generate a single CSS theme file and ask the user to load it
body: Remove any CSS infrastructure and themeable code.

comments.body: Hi @adlenafane I saw you :+1:, can you provide more context on why do you think what we want to do here is good? (Thanks!)

Hi @vvo, it's mainly related to https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/1489 in my situation. I'd like to use react-instantsearch with a server rendering first (I use https://www.reactstarterkit.com/) and I have an issue with `insert-css`.
I had a quicklook of the themeable and find it quite invasive in all components
Allright perfect then it's were we are aimed at, reducing the styling API surface to only CSS class names and exposing the generated CSS in a way so you can insert it.

Here are the steps I identified and propose to do:

  - apply CSS classes manually
  - remove theme, themeable
  - keep individual CSS files
  - make the theme a separate package (allows updating the theme without having to update react-instantsearch)
  - add necessary build step to allow
    import theme from react-instantsearch-themes-algolia
    insertCSS(theme)
    npmcdn CSS file for ease of download/test/prototype
  - update documentation to point to npmcdn CSS file, show
  how to load it via npm too
  - update our documentation site to load default theme
